[ASSISTANT_SAID] California offers scenic and diverse bike routes for multi-day trips.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended routes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Pacific Coast Highway (Hwy 1) - 655 miles from Leggett to San Diego.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested sections for Pacific Coast Highway:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Leggett to Cambria (3-4 days) through redwood forests and Big Sur.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Cambria to Santa Barbara (3-4 days) passing through Morro Bay and San Luis Obispo.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Santa Barbara to San Diego (4-5 days) exploring Santa Monica Mountains and Malibu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sierra Nevada Mountain Routes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Tahoe to Yosemite (3-4 days) from South Lake Tahoe to Yosemite Valley.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Mammoth Lakes to Bishop (2-3 days) through the Eastern Sierra.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Central Coast and Wine Country routes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - San Luis Obispo to Paso Robles (2-3 days) through Edna Valley and Paso Robles wine country.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Santa Cruz to Napa Valley (3-4 days) through Santa Cruz Mountains and Napa Valley wine country.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Desert Routes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Death Valley to Joshua Tree (3-4 days) through unique landscapes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Palm Springs to Borrego Springs (2-3 days) through Coachella Valley and Anza-Borrego Desert State Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Before the trip, users should plan their itinerary, check road conditions, pack essential gear, and train physically.
